understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions changed the player’s column, after which gravity carried the player until landing on a solid tile, entering a new section, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity was DOWN in the observed turns. Spike tiles were fatal, while support tiles were safe. CLICK targeted and removed breakable x tiles without moving the player, and clicks did not advance the rising-platform timer. UNDO could revert the previous action. The corridor and landing previews should have been used to choose passage columns and avoid unsafe landings within the limited attempts and turns.
